_about: Dispersion formulas copied from the refractiveindex.info database (CC0 1.0). B and C are exactly the coefficients in the database YAML files, in source order. The formula string says literally how C enters: formula type 1 (database "Sellmeier") squares C_i in the denominator, so C_i is in um; formula type 2 (database "Sellmeier-2") uses C_i as given, so C_i is in um^2. Definitions taken from the database document "Dispersion formulas.pdf". A is the leading constant coefficient of the database formula (0 for every entry here). nd and Vd are the catalogue values stored in the YAML, null where the source gives none. n_at_587p56nm_computed is derived here from the recorded formula, for cross-checking only.

N-BK7.name: SCHOTT N-BK7
N-BK7.reference: SCHOTT Zemax catalog 2017-01-20b, as carried by the refractiveindex.info database
N-BK7.formula: n^2 = 1 + A + sum_i B_i L^2 / (L^2 - C_i), L in um
N-BK7.C_meaning: C_i in um^2; the denominator uses C_i as given (not squared)

fused_silica.name: Fused silica (SiO2), 20 C
fused_silica.reference: I. H. Malitson, J. Opt. Soc. Am. 55, 1205-1208 (1965), doi:10.1364/JOSA.55.001205. Formula reported for 0.21-3.71 um; the database extends the range to 6.7 um citing C. Z. Tan, J. Non-Cryst. Solids 223, 158-163 (1998)
fused_silica.formula: n^2 = 1 + A + sum_i B_i L^2 / (L^2 - C_i^2), L in um
fused_silica.C_meaning: C_i in um; the denominator uses C_i squared
